title: Contributors
intro: Find shared Contributor records, correct them, or merge an accidental duplicate into the record to keep.
countUnavailable: The number of matching contributors is unavailable.
loadFailed: Contributors could not be loaded. Please try again.
saveFailed: The contributor could not be saved.
mergePreviewFailed: The credits could not be read, so nothing was changed.
mergeConflicts: Works that already credit the contributor you keep: {{count}}. Their credits are not moved and the duplicate is not deleted.
mergeWarning: Each credit is moved one at a time and the duplicate is deleted only when no credits remain. This is not undone by Thoth. If it stops part-way, run it again for the same pair to continue.
resultDeleted: Done. {{count}} credits were moved and the duplicate was deleted.
resultCreditFailed: Stopped: a credit could not be moved ({{count}} moved before this). The duplicate was not deleted. Run the merge again to continue.
resultCreditsRemain: Stopped: credits remain on the duplicate, so it was not deleted. Check works that already credit the contributor you keep.
resultReadFailed: Stopped: Thoth could not be read reliably, so nothing further was changed and the duplicate was not deleted.
resultDeleteFailed: All credits were moved, but the duplicate could not be deleted. Run the merge again to retry the delete.
notAuthorized: This page is available to Thoth staff only.
